# Majestic Exteriors

> Roofing, siding and gutter contractor based at 4520 S Decatur St, Englewood, Colorado, serving homes and commercial buildings across Greater Denver. Owner Jake Motzko has more than 20 years of roofing experience. Inspections and written estimates are free.

## Services
- Roofing (https://majesticexteriors.net/roofing/): replacement and repair in asphalt shingle, metal, concrete and clay tile, wood shingle and shake, copper, and commercial single-ply and modified systems.
- Hail damage and insurance claims (https://majesticexteriors.net/hail-damage-insurance-claims/): free inspections with photo documentation, adjuster meetings and claim support through final payment.
- Siding (https://majesticexteriors.net/siding/): vinyl, aluminum, James Hardie fiber cement and T1-11.
- Gutters (https://majesticexteriors.net/gutters/): aluminum and steel (galvanized or stainless) gutters and downspouts.

## FAQ
### How do I know if hail damaged my roof?
You usually can't tell from the ground. Look for dents in gutters, downspouts, window screens and metal vents, and for shingle granules collecting at downspout outlets. Hail about 1 inch across (quarter size) or larger often bruises asphalt shingles. Majestic Exteriors inspects roofs for free and photographs any damage so you can decide whether to file a claim.

### Will homeowners insurance pay for a new roof after hail in Colorado?
If a covered storm damaged the roof, most Colorado homeowners policies pay to repair or replace it, minus your deductible. Older or cosmetic-damage exclusions vary by policy, so check yours. Majestic Exteriors documents the damage, meets your adjuster on the roof, and helps with the paperwork until the claim is settled.

### Can a roofer pay or waive my insurance deductible in Colorado?
No. Colorado law (C.R.S. 10-4-110.8) bars roofing contractors from paying, waiving or rebating a homeowner's insurance deductible, and a contractor who offers to is breaking the law. Majestic Exteriors bills your deductible as required.

### How long does a roof replacement take?
Most single-family asphalt shingle roofs are replaced in one to two days once materials arrive, weather permitting. Larger, steeper, tile, metal and commercial roofs take longer. You get a written schedule with your estimate.

### How much does a new roof cost in the Denver area?
Price depends on roof size, pitch, layers to tear off, and material. Asphalt shingles cost least, then metal, tile, wood shake and copper. Majestic Exteriors gives free written estimates, and when hail caused the damage your insurer usually pays most of the cost.

### What is a Class 4 impact-resistant roof?
Class 4 is the highest rating under the UL 2218 impact test, in which steel balls up to 2 inches are dropped on the roofing. Class 4 shingles hold up better to Colorado hail, and some insurers offer a premium discount for them. Ask your insurer whether yours does.

### What roofing, siding and gutter materials do you install?
Roofing: asphalt shingle, metal, concrete and clay tile, wood shingle and shake, copper, and single-ply and modified commercial systems. Siding: vinyl, aluminum, James Hardie fiber cement and T1-11. Gutters: aluminum and steel, including galvanized and stainless.

### Do you work on commercial buildings?
Yes. Majestic Exteriors repairs and installs roofs on high-rise condominiums, industrial, retail and commercial buildings as well as single-family homes, and is an approved applicator for many leading insurance carriers. References are available on request.

### What areas do you serve?
Majestic Exteriors is based in Englewood and serves the Greater Denver area, including Denver, Littleton, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Highlands Ranch, Lone Tree, Parker, Castle Rock, Aurora, Lakewood, Golden, Arvada, Westminster and Broomfield.
